justification: Although the case involves assembly rights and reaches genuine Article 11 merits findings, the analysis is not a single coherent unified analysis — it covers multiple distinct incidents across two applicants with different outcomes (violations for Achilov, no violation for Ivanov), and in at least one instance (the 10 August 2007 demonstration for Achilov) the Court itself acknowledges that the relevant facts were not properly established in domestic proceedings, meaning the facts are not treated as settled.
